why: Block with Kird Ape (1/1) against Grizzly Bears (2/2). Both creatures die in combat, but it saves me 2 life points (stay at 11 vs drop to 9). More importantly, it removes one of their two 2/2 creatures, leaving only the summoning-sick Bears unable to attack. Next turn I'll cast Bonebreaker Giant with better board position and higher life total.
